messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ஆஹா என்ன என்று சொல்லுவது கடினமான ஒன்று இந்த காடு காட்டு கடினமான அடர்த்தியானது அது மனதில் பயத்தை மீண்டும் எழுப்புகிறது!

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Tamil translation)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------|--------| | **Ahi** | Exclamatory “Ah!” | **ஆஹா** | “Ah!” | OK | | **quanto** | Degree intensifier “how (much) …” | **என்ன** | “what” (used as “how”) | **WRONG** | | **a** | Infinitive marker “to” | *(none)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **dir** | Verb “to tell / say” | **சொல்லுவது** | “to say / telling” | OK | | **qual** | Interrogative “what” (object of *dir*) | **என்ன** | “what” | OK | | **era** | Imperfect “was” (past copula) | *(none)* | – | **MISSING** | | **è** | Present “is” (copula) | *(none)* | – | **MISSING** | | **cosa** | Abstract “thing” (subject) | **ஒன்று** | “one / thing” | OK | | **dura** | Adjective “hard / difficult” | **கடினமான** | “hard / difficult” | OK | | **esta** | Demonstrative “this” | **இந்த** | “this” | OK | | **selva** | Noun “forest / wood” | **காடு** | “forest / wood” | OK | | **selvaggia** | Adj. “wild” | **காட்டு** | “wild” | OK | | **e** (1st) | Coordinating “and” | *(none)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **aspra** | Adj. “rough” | **கடினமான** | “rough / hard” | OK | | **e** (2nd) | Coordinating “and” | *(none)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **forte** | Adj. “strong / dense” | **அடர்த்தியானது** | “dense / strong” | OK | | **che** | Relative pronoun “which / that” | **அது** | “that” | OK | | **nel** | Prepositional phrase “in the” (locative) | **மனதில்** | “in the mind” | OK | | **pensier** | Noun “thought” | **மனதில்** | “thought / mind” (merged with *nel*) | OK | | **rinova** | Verb “renews / revives” | **மீண்டும் எழுப்புகிறது** | “renews / brings up again” | OK | | **la** | Definite article “the” | *(none)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **paura!** | Noun “fear” (object) | **பயத்தை** | “fear” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention
- **WRONG**: *quanto* – rendered as “என்ன” (“what”) instead of a proper degree intensifier such as “எவ்வளவு”. - **MISSING**: *era* and *è* – the past and present copular verbs are omitted; Tamil can convey state without an explicit copula, but the reference translation includes “was / is”, so their absence is a loss of explicit tense marking. - **UNNECESSARY**: *a*, *e* (both occurrences), *la* – Tamil naturally omits infinitive markers, coordinating conjunctions (when adjectives are stacked) and definite articles, so their absence is acceptable but flagged for completeness. - **GRAMMAR**: None of the retained elements show agreement or case errors in the Tamil output.
These notes can guide a refined revision of the Tamil rendering to better mirror the source semantics while respecting Tamil grammatical norms.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 4** - **Original:** ஆஹா என்ன என்று சொல்லுவது கடினமான ஒன்று - **Issue:** *quanto* rendered incorrectly, missing past copula *era* and present copula *è* - **Corrected:** ஆஹா எவ்வளவு சொல்லுவது அது இருந்தது என்பது கடினமான ஒன்று
- **Line 5** - **Original:** இந்த காடு காட்டு கடினமான அடர்த்தியானது - **Issue:** none - **Corrected:** இந்த காடு காட்டு கடினமான அடர்த்தியானது
- **Line 6** - **Original:** அது மனதில் பயத்தை மீண்டும் எழுப்புகிறது! - **Issue:** none - **Corrected:** அது மனதில் பயத்தை மீண்டும் எழுப்புகிறது!
